traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Iteaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins serrate or dentate; leaves evergreen or deciduous; stipules present; plants hermaphrodite or polygamous; ovary superior or half inferior; floral cup present; stems woody; flowers in racemes or in panicles; flowers actinomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; fruit capsule; parts of each whorl 5; stamens 5; carpels 2. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
